hero.title: Transform Fremantle
hero.subtitle: United in prayer for the transformation of our city

paragraphs: We are a group of Christians from various churches, united in prayer for the transformation of the City of Fremantle.
Our vision is for Fremantle to be a peaceful city where multitudes encounter Jesus, transform their lives, and go on to serve Christ.

meetingsSection.heading: Prayer Meetings
meetingsSection.intro: We warmly invite all Christians to join us at the Transform Fremantle prayer meetings held throughout the week.

meetings.address: Upstairs in the E-shed markets, Peter Hughes Drive, Fremantle WA 6160

meetings.note: * Youth & young adults focused (but all ages are welcome).

unity.heading: Unity in Essentials
unity.quote: "In essentials, unity; in non-essentials, liberty; in all things, charity."
unity.body: We recognize that Christians may differ on secondary matters of theology and practice. What unites us is far greater than what divides us - our common faith in Jesus Christ and our shared mission to see His kingdom come in Fremantle.
